head: MyPlantMap maps your garden plants on satellite images
dek: MyPlantMap lets gardeners and homeowners catalog, track and plan plants directly on high-resolution satellite images of their property. It was #37 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 5 November.
details: It came out on 4 November and costs $4.99, by Sharon Dankwardt.
means: If you plan a garden or keep track of many plants, you can see them on a map of your own yard.
todo: Find MyPlantMap in the App Store.
